t: Ozi handles the spoke, Octo handles the hub — canonical naming for autonomous agents
description: User confirmed the naming convention: Ozi is the spoke-level autonomous agent (chief of staff, work queue, dispatch). Octo is the hub-level autonomous agent (fleet coordination, cross-spoke routing, gardener orchestration). The naming is poetic and functional — Ozi handles one spoke's concerns, Octo extends across all spokes via the hub.
implications: All spoke-level autonomous features should be under the Ozi namespace
All hub-level autonomous features should be under the Octo namespace
Chain mode (tools/wai-chain.sh) is Ozi-driven — it spawns spoke sessions
Fleet-wide operations (tender, gardener, signal routing) are Octo-driven
